## Production memo API handlers that broadcast via SSE hub

These are all `APIV1Service` gRPC/Connect handlers under `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1` that trigger `s.SSEHub.Broadcast` (directly or through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`).

### Direct `s.SSEHub.Broadcast` calls

| Method | File | Event type |
|--------|------|------------|
| `CreateMemo` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.created` (skipped when called internally with suppressed SSE, e.g. from `CreateMemoComment`) |
| `DeleteMemo` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `memo.deleted` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` | `memo.comment.created` |
| `UpsertMemoReaction` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` | `reaction.upserted` (via `buildMemoReactionSSEEvent`) |
| `DeleteMemoReaction` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` | `reaction.deleted` (via `buildMemoReactionSSEEvent`) |

### Indirect broadcast via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`

These handlers call `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go`, which performs `s.SSEHub.Broadcast` with `memo.updated`:

| Method | File |
|--------|------|
| `UpdateMemo` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` |

### Excluded (per your criteria)

- **`dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`** — helper, not an API handler
- **`handleSSE`** / **`RegisterSSERoutes`** — SSE subscription endpoint, not memo mutation handlers
- **`buildMemoReactionSSEEvent`** — event builder only
- All `*_test.go` files and `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/test/`

No other production memo handlers in this directory broadcast through the SSE hub (checked `memo_share_service.go`, `memo_attachment_service.go` list methods, etc.).

---

## Hub implementation

| Component | File |
|-----------|------|
| **`SSEHub` type, `Broadcast`, `Subscribe`, `Unsubscribe`** | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` |
| **SSE HTTP endpoint** (`GET /api/v1/sse`) | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` |
| **Hub wiring** (`NewSSEHub()`, route registration) | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` |

---

## Browser push mechanism

**Server-Sent Events (SSE)** over `GET /api/v1/sse` with `Content-Type: text/event-stream`. The server writes `data: {json}\n\n` frames; heartbeats use SSE comment lines (`: heartbeat\n\n`).

**Client:** `/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts`

- Uses **`fetch()` + `ReadableStream`** (not the native `EventSource` API), so it can send a `Bearer` token in `Authorization`
- Mounted globally from `/bench/repo/web/src/main.tsx` via `useLiveMemoRefresh()`
- On events, invalidates React Query caches (`memoKeys`, `userKeys.stats()`) to refresh the UI in real time
- Connection status exposed via `useSSEConnectionStatus()` (used in `/bench/repo/web/src/components/UserMenu.tsx`)
